mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students ( id, name, kana_name, nickname, email, area, age, sex, remark, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{kanaName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{area}, #{age}, #{sex}, #{remark}, false )
INSERT INTO students_courses ( id, student_id, course_name, course_start_at, course_end_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{courseStartAt}, #{courseEndAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name = #{name}, kana_name = #{kanaName}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, area = #{area}, age = #{age}, sex = #{sex}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
